channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Apple rolls out hypertension alerts in India; over 1 million users expected to benefit
item.description: Apple has begun rolling out hypertension notifications for Apple Watch users in India, a major health update first announced at the iPhone 17 launch and now available on select models.

item.title: Ranveer Singh Dhurandhar row: Yami Gautam exposes 'paid negative PR', Hrithik Roshan voices support
item.description: A day before the release of Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar, his wife, actress Yami Gautam, took to social media to share a lengthy note about ending the trend of creating hype. She criticised the negative paid media culture and highlighted how Dhurandhar is facing the concept of cancel culture even before its release. Echoing her views, her Kaabil co-star Hrithik Roshan also responded.

item.title: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrives on two-day State Visit, received by PM Modi at airport
item.description: The two leaders warmly hugged and greeted each other at the tarmac before leaving the airport together in the same vehicle.

item.title: Personal Loan Approvals in 2025: What Lenders Look For In Your Application
item.description: IDFC FIRST Bank, offer 100% digital process, that doesn't require any paperwork. This makes the application process smooth and disbursals quick, and tools like an emi calculator for personal loan further simplify planning your repayments

item.title: Survika Traders Private Limited brings simple RBI approved loans for Indian borrowers
item.description: Survika Traders offers supply chain finance that gives smooth cash flow. With this support businesses pay workers on time.

item.title: Priyanka Chopra locks lips with Nick Jonas during hand–footprint ceremony; Nick's romantic speech wins hearts
item.description: The Jonas Brothers - Nick, Joe, and Kevin added their hand and footprints at the iconic TCL Chinese Theatre in Hollywood. During the special ceremony on Wednesday, the brothers received the special honours as they pressed their hands and feet into the cement amid the presence of family members and fans.

item.title: US cuts work permit duration, impacting thousands of Indian workers
item.description: USCIS said the revised policy will "result in more frequent vetting of aliens who apply for authorization to work in the United States," enabling the agency to "deter fraud and detect aliens with potentially harmful intent so they can be processed for removal from the United States."

item.title: US sees India as key AI partner amid growing China challenge
item.description: During a Senate hearing on Tuesday (December 2), witnesses stressed that the coming year will require deeper coordination among democratic partners — including India — to shape global AI standards, safeguard chip supply chains, and counter Beijing's ambitions.

item.title: Govt closely monitoring IndiGo's flight fiasco, Naidu expresses 'clear displeasure'
item.description: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu has chaired a high-level review meeting with IndiGo's senior management in the presence of the Secretary, Civil Aviation, Director General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), senior officials of the Ministry, and the Airports Authority of India (AAI).

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower as investors await RBI's MPC decision
item.description: At the opening bell, the Sensex was at 85,187, down 79 points or 0.09 per cent. The Nifty also saw a mild decline, slipping 12 points or 0.05 per cent to 26,021.
